entries.domain_definition: The property of an operation whereby applying it multiple consecutive times produces the identical outcome as once.

A practical computational shortcut or rule-of-thumb strategy that is not guaranteed to be optimal but is fast.
Horizontally partitioning a database or dataset across multiple server instances to distribute write load.
